_doc: Evidence the castable-script test (tools/script_rights.py) reads. Every entry needs a source a reader can open. A registration here is never enough on its own: a script registered 1931-1963 also needs a recorded renewal search (renewal_search) before it can be cast, because the printed renewal file loses a quarter to a third of its entries to OCR (research 08b §1.3).

Generic Radio Workshop.note: GRW's texts are volunteer transcriptions with added notes; reuse waits on asking GRW (research 08 C8). The work may still be free: the same play from another source is judged on that source's record.

Uncle Sam's Forest Rangers.note: Series-level only. Research 08b §1.2: each script needs its author and employer on record before it is classed government work (collection is not authorship).
